llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reports are sourced from a Jotai async atom and include a refresh trigger read via `get`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: reportsAtom is defined as atom(async (get) => ...) and explicitly calls get(refreshAtom) to read the refresh trigger before fetching.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Implementation includes a helper that adapts an async atom using Jotai `unwrap` plus a derived `atom((get) => ...)` read function with try/catch error capture
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Implementation uses jotai/utils loadable(reportsAtom) directly, not a custom helper built with unwrap plus a derived atom((get) => ...) with try/catch error capture.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Helper returns explicit loadable objects for loading data and error states (including payload for data/error), and UI branches directly on that returned state shape
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: UI branches on state === 'loading', state === 'hasError' (with reportsState.error payload), and state === 'hasData' (with reportsState.data payload), matching a loadable state shape.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reload action updates the refresh trigger atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: reloadReportsAtom write handler calls set(refreshAtom, count => count + 1), and is wired to the Reload button via useSetAtom(reloadReportsAtom).
evidence: const reloadReportsAtom = atom(null, (_get, set) => { set(refreshAtom, (count) => count + 1) })
